definitions.explanation: The regional dialect spoken in the Kansai area, including Osaka, Kyoto, and Kobe. One of the most widely recognized and influential dialects in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{関西弁|かんさいべん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
{関西弁|かんさいべん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|した}しみやすい→親しみやすい：19142_shitashimiyasui⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The Kansai dialect gives a friendly impression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{関西弁|かんさいべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けない→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧。
examples.english: Even after moving to Tokyo, I can't shake my Kansai dialect.

notes:
USAGE:
Often discussed in comparison with standard Japanese (⟦{標準語|ひょうじゅんご}→標準語：07421_hyoujungo⟧). Kansai dialect is famous for distinctive features like ～⟦やん→やる：02980_yaru⟧, ～やねん, なん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧やねん, and ⟦おおきに→おおきに：07530_ookini⟧. It is widely heard in comedy (⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧) and pop culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関西弁|かんさいべん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak in Kansai dialect)
- {関西弁|かんさいべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (one's Kansai dialect comes out)
- {関西弁|かんさいべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けない→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (can't get rid of one's Kansai dialect)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大阪弁|おおさかべん}→大阪弁：24356_oosakaben⟧: Osaka dialect — specifically the Osaka variety of Kansai speech
- ⟦{京都弁|きょうとべん}→京都弁：24355_kyoutoben⟧: Kyoto dialect — often considered softer and more elegant
- ⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧: dialect — the general term for any regional dialect
